title: Stop Doing This At Highway Exits (Part 2)
hook: Never brake before entering the deceleration lane.

script.narration: Never brake before entering the deceleration lane.

Part 2! Maintain your highway speed until your entire car is fully inside the deceleration lane. Only then should you begin applying steady brake pressure. Braking early on the main highway surprises drivers behind you and creates unnecessary rear-end collision risks.

description: Master highway exit safety in part 2 of our series. Learn the exact speed management technique to use once you are inside the exit lane. Never brake on the main highway before transitioning into the exit lane.
